subject.title: Feature: Cross-platform multi-select component in message tool

question: Should OpenClaw add a portable multi-select batch-selection contract to the shared message tool/message-presentation API, or leave this workflow to plugin/ClawHub-specific surfaces?
rationale: The missing behavior crosses a public agent tool, Plugin SDK types, docs, and multiple channel render/callback paths, so the durable API boundary and fallback semantics need maintainer product direction before implementation.

options.title: Add Shared Portable Contract
options.body: Define a narrow additive multi-select block/action contract and implement channel-specific render plus callback aggregation behind the existing message presentation boundary.

options.title: Keep Plugin-Only
options.body: Close or redirect this as a ClawHub/plugin workflow if maintainers decide the current before_agent_reply and plugin hooks are sufficient without changing the shared message tool.

options.title: Split By Channel
options.body: Track Slack, Discord, Telegram, and fallback behavior separately if maintainers prefer native channel work before a cross-platform abstraction.

recommendation.title: Add Shared Portable Contract
recommendation.body: Define a narrow additive multi-select block/action contract and implement channel-specific render plus callback aggregation behind the existing message presentation boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: The current shared presentation and message-tool schema provenance points most strongly to this owner path, and the decision is about that public contract boundary.
